title: Ukuhamba nsuku zonke
description: Ten short stories about getting around: a bus strike in Johannesburg, an overnight bus to a concert, a walk to school across a stream, a drive through a game reserve, a lobola journey to Qunu, an old car and its insurance, a folk tale of a forest path and an ogre, a holiday on a grandmother's farm, a train to a football final, and a trip to Egypt.

lessons.title: Isiteleka samabhasi
lessons.summary: Mpumi of Soweto finds no bus because the bus drivers are on strike; she complains, looks for another way, walks to work in Johannesburg past traffic lights that are out, rests her sore heel on a bench, and hears on TV that the buses run again tomorrow.
lessons.text:
UMpumi uhlala eSoweto, kodwa usebenza eGoli, esitolo esikhulu sezingubo. Nsuku zonke uvuka ekuseni kakhulu, agibele ibhasi aye emsebenzini. Uhambo luthatha ihora elilodwa.

NgoMsombuluko ekuseni uMpumi ulinda ibhasi endaweni yakhe yamabhasi, kodwa ibhasi alifiki. Kunabantu abaningi abalindile lapho. Indoda emdala ithi: "Abashayeli bamabhasi bayateleka namuhla. Bathi imali abayitholayo incane kakhulu."

UMpumi uyakhononda: "Kungani beteleka namuhla? Ngizofika emsebenzini emva kwesikhathi!" Abanye abantu nabo bayakhononda. Kodwa ukukhononda akusizi lutho. Akukho bhasi elizofika.

UMpumi ucinga enye indlela. Ucinga imoto yomakhelwane, kodwa umakhelwane akekho, uhambile ekuseni kakhulu. Ucinga isitimela, kodwa isitimela sigcwele kakhulu namuhla. Ngeshwa, akanayo imali eningi. Ngakho unquma ukuhamba ngezinyawo.

Uhamba emgwaqweni omude. Izimoto ziningi kakhulu, ngoba abantu abaningi bashayela izimoto zabo namuhla. Ngeshwa, amanye amarobhothi awasebenzi, ngoba ugesi awukho. Amaphoyisa amaningi asemarobhothini, akhombisa izimoto ukuthi zihambe nini. UMpumi uyaxwaya. Ulinda irobhothi libe luhlaza, bese ehamba. Uzitshela ukuthi: "Xwaya, Mpumi. Izimoto ziningi namuhla."

Ngemuva kwamahora amabili uMpumi udiniwe. Izicathulo zakhe zintsha, futhi isithende sakhe sibuhlungu. Uhlala ebhentshini eduze komgwaqo. Ukhumula isicathulo, abheke isithende sakhe. Isithende sibomvu.

Owesifazane omdala uhlala naye ebhentshini. Naye udiniwe, ngoba uhambe ngezinyawo kusukela eSoweto. Uthi: "Ngane yami, nami ngiyakhononda, kodwa abashayeli nabo banezinkinga. Abantwana babo badinga ukudla."

UMpumi ufika emsebenzini ngehora leshumi. Akathethiswa, ngoba nabanye abasebenzi bafika emva kwesikhathi.

Kusihlwa uMpumi ubuyela ekhaya ngezinyawo futhi, ngoba isiteleka asiphelanga. Udiniwe kakhulu, kodwa uyaqhubeka. Ebusuku ubuka izindaba kumabonakude. Izindaba zithi abashayeli bazobuyela emsebenzini ngomuso. UMpumi uyajabula. Uthi kumama wakhe: "Ngomuso ngizogibela ibhasi. Isithende sami sizophumula ngomuso."

Imibuzo:
Kungani ibhasi lingafiki?
Ngoba abashayeli bamabhasi bayateleka, bathi imali abayitholayo incane.
UMpumi ucinga ziphi ezinye izindlela?
Ucinga imoto yomakhelwane nesitimela, kodwa umakhelwane wayehambile futhi isitimela sigcwele.
Kungani uMpumi exwaya emgwaqweni?
Ngoba izimoto ziningi, futhi amanye amarobhothi awasebenzi.
Kwenzekani esithendeni sakhe?
Isithende sakhe sibuhlungu futhi sibomvu, ngoba izicathulo zakhe zintsha.
Abashayeli bazobuyela nini emsebenzini?
Bazobuyela emsebenzini ngomuso.

lessons.title: Ibhasi eya ekhonsathini
lessons.summary: Nonhle and Busisiwe ride an overnight bus from Vryheid to a concert in a Durban hall; a drunk man drinks beer and talks nonsense about demons, the singer makes the crowd laugh, young men do a Zulu dance, and the singer says goodbye.
lessons.text:
UNonhle uhlala eVryheid. Umculi amthanda kakhulu uzohlabelela ekhonsathini eThekwini ngoMgqibelo. UNonhle nomngane wakhe uBusisiwe bathenga amathikithi ekhonsathi. NgoLwesihlanu ebusuku bagibela ibhasi elikhulu eliya eThekwini.

Ebhasini kukhona abantu abaningi abaya ekhonsathini. Bonke bajabulile. Bahlabelela izingoma zomculi ebhasini, futhi uNonhle noBusisiwe nabo bayahlabelela.

Ngemuva kwehora, indoda ehlezi ngemuva kwabo ivula ubhiya. Iphuza ubhiya owodwa, bese iphuza omunye, nomunye futhi. Ngemuva kwamahora amabili indoda idakiwe. Indoda edakiwe ikhuluma kakhulu. Iyabheda. Ithi umculi ungumzala wayo. Ithi ibhasi ligcwele amadimoni. Ithi: "Ngiyawabona amadimoni! Ahlezi ophahleni lwebhasi!"

Abanye abantu bayahleka, abanye bayathukuthela. Indoda eshayela ibhasi ibeka ibhasi eceleni komgwaqo, ithi endodeni: "Baba, uyabheda. Akukho madimoni lapha. Udakiwe nje. Ungabe usaphuza ubhiya. Hlala phansi, ulale." Indoda ithi: "Angidakiwe!" Kodwa ngemuva kwemizuzu emihlanu iyalala. Ebhasini kuthule.

Ekuseni ibhasi lifika eThekwini. Ikhonsathi izoba ehholo elikhulu edolobheni kusihlwa. UNonhle noBusisiwe bahamba ogwini usuku lonke, bese beya ehholo.

Ehholo kunabantu abayizinkulungwane ezintathu. Umculi uyafika, ahlabelele. Abantu bahlabelela naye. Ihholo ligcwele umsindo nokujabula.

Phakathi kwezingoma, umculi uyahlekisa. Uxoxa ngomama wakhe. Uthi umama wakhe wayemshaya ngesicathulo uma engafuni ukuhlabelela esontweni. Abantu bahleka kakhulu. UNonhle uthi: "Lo mculi akagcini nje ngokuhlabelela. Uyasihlekisa futhi!"

Bese kufika abafana abagqoke izikhumba. Bayagiya. Bagiya ngamandla, bashaye phansi ngezinyawo. Ihholo lonke liyanyakaza. Umdanso wabo muhle kakhulu. Ngemuva komdanso wabafana, umculi ufundisa abantu umdanso omusha. UNonhle noBusisiwe bayawufunda umdanso, badanse kuze kube sebusuku.

Ehholo uNonhle ubona indoda yasebhasini. Manje ayidakiwe. Iyamazi uNonhle, ithi: "Ngiyaxolisa ngezolo. Ngabheda kakhulu ebhasini."

Ekugcineni umculi uyavalelisa. Uthi: "Ngiyabonga, Thekwini! Hambani kahle!" Abantu bamvalelisa ngezandla. UNonhle noBusisiwe bavalelisa abangane abasha abahlangane nabo ehholo, bagibela ibhasi babuyele eVryheid.

Imibuzo:
UNonhle noBusisiwe baya kuphi?
Baya ekhonsathini eThekwini.
Kwenzekani endodeni ehlezi ngemuva kwabo?
Iphuza ubhiya omningi, idakwe, futhi ibheda ngamadimoni.
Umculi uhlekisa kanjani abantu?
Uthi umama wakhe wayemshaya ngesicathulo uma engafuni ukuhlabelela.
Abafana abagqoke izikhumba benzani?
Bayagiya, bashaye phansi ngezinyawo.
Indoda yasebhasini ithini ehholo?
Ithi iyaxolisa, ngoba yabheda kakhulu ebhasini.

lessons.title: Indlela eya esikoleni
lessons.summary: On a sunny day Mfanimpela walks to school near Nongoma across a stream with tiny fish, meets the kind old herdsman Biyela with his stick, his fighting ram and his lost white ox, and after school swims naked with friends while the ram eats his jersey.
lessons.text:
UMfanimpela uneminyaka eyishumi. Uhlala esigodini eduze kwaseNongoma. Isikole sakhe sikude: uhamba ngezinyawo amakhilomitha amane ekuseni, namakhilomitha amane ngemuva kwesikole. Akukho bhasi esigodini sabo.

NgoLwesithathu libalele. Izulu liluhlaza, alikho ifu. UMfanimpela uphuma ekhaya ekuseni kakhulu. Ulandela indlela encane edlula emasimini.

Endleleni kukhona umfudlana. Umfudlana awujulile, kodwa amanzi awo ayabanda ekuseni. UMfanimpela ukhumula izicathulo, ahambe emanzini. Ezinyaweni zakhe kukhona izinhlanzi ezincinyane, ezincinyane kakhulu, njengeminwe yengane encane.

Ngale komfudlana kukhona umelusi. Ngumelusi omdala, ikhehla elibizwa ngokuthi uBiyela. Ikhehla libheka izinkomo nezimvu zomuzi walo. Liphethe intonga enkulu. Phakathi kwezimvu kukhona inqama enkulu enezimpondo. Zonke izinkomo zalo zimnyama, kodwa ikhehla linomhlophe futhi, inkomo enkulu emhlophe njengobisi. Namuhla umhlophe akekho phakathi kwezinkomo. Ubalekile ebusuku, futhi ikhehla liyamfuna.

Ikhehla limnene kakhulu, futhi linezwi elimnene. Lithi: "Sakubona, mfana wami. Uvukile kahle?" UMfanimpela uthi: "Yebo, baba." Bese ikhehla lithi: "Xwaya inqama yami. Ithanda ukulwa namuhla."

Inqama ime phakathi kwendlela. Ayifuni ukuhamba. UMfanimpela uyesaba. Ikhehla lithatha intonga yalo, lithinte inqama kancane ngentonga. Inqama iyahamba. Ikhehla alishayi inqama, ngoba limnene nasezilwaneni zalo.

Ngemuva kwesikole uMfanimpela ubuyela ekhaya. Lisabalele, futhi kuyashisa kakhulu. Ikhehla lisacinga umhlophe walo. Emfudlaneni kukhona abafana abathathu besikole sakhe. Bakhumule zonke izingubo zabo, bazibeka otshanini. Babhukuda emfudlaneni ngobunqunu. Bathi: "Woza, Mfanimpela! Amanzi mahle!" UMfanimpela uyakhumula naye, abhukude ngobunqunu nabangane bakhe.

Bese uMfanimpela ubona inqama! Iseduze kwezingubo zabo, idla ijezi lakhe lesikole. UMfanimpela uphuma emanzini ngobunqunu, agijime. Abangane bakhe bayahleka.

Ikhehla liyafika nentonga yalo. Liqhuba inqama ngentonga, linike uMfanimpela ijezi lakhe. Ijezi linembobo encinyane. Ikhehla lithi: "Ngiyaxolisa, mfana wami. Uzotshela umama wakho ukuthi inqama kaBiyela idle ijezi lakho." Bese lithi: "Umhlophe wami ubuyile. Ngimtholile eduze komfudlana."

Imibuzo:
Kungani uMfanimpela ehamba ngezinyawo?
Ngoba isikole sikude futhi akukho bhasi esigodini sabo.
Ubani uBiyela?
Ngumelusi omdala, ikhehla elibheka izinkomo nezimvu.
Kungani uMfanimpela exwaya inqama?
Ngoba ikhehla lithi inqama ithanda ukulwa namuhla.
Abafana benzani emfudlaneni ngemuva kwesikole?
Babhukuda ngobunqunu, ngoba libalele futhi kuyashisa kakhulu.
Inqama yenzani?
Idla ijezi likaMfanimpela, futhi ijezi linembobo encinyane.

lessons.title: Ehlathini lezilwane
lessons.summary: Mandlenkosi drives his daughter Nomzi through the Hluhluwe game reserve; she unrolls the map, they watch elephants suck up water, one elephant shakes the car and shocks them, a lioness licks her cubs, and they see a rare rhino.
lessons.text:
UMandlenkosi Khoza nendodakazi yakhe uNomzi bahamba ngemoto baye ehlathini lezilwane eHluhluwe. UNomzi uneminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye. Akabonanga izilwane ezinkulu ngaphambili.

Lapho bengena ehlathini, indoda ibanika ibalazwe. Ibalazwe lenziwe ngephepha elikhulu. UNomzi uyalisombulula ibalazwe emadolweni akhe. Ulisombulula kancane, ngoba likhulu. Ebalazweni kukhona imigwaqo yonke yehlathi, nezindawo lapho izilwane ziphuza khona amanzi.

UNomzi ubheka ibalazwe, athi: "Baba, ake sihambe kulo mgwaqo. Ibalazwe lithi kukhona ichibi lapho izindlovu ziphuza khona."

UMandlenkosi ushayela imoto kancane. Ngemuva kwemizuzu engamashumi amabili bafika echibini. Kukhona izindlovu eziyisishiyagalombili. Indlovu enkulu ifaka ikhala layo elide emanzini. Iyamunca amanzi ngekhala, bese iwathela emlonyeni wayo. Izindlovu ezincane nazo ziyamunca amanzi. UNomzi uthi: "Bheka, baba! Zimunca amanzi njengoba mina ngimunca ubisi!"

Bese indlovu enkulu iza ngasemotweni. Ibeka ikhala layo emotweni, inyakazise imoto. Imoto iyanyakaza. UNomzi uyashaqeka. UMandlenkosi naye uyashaqeka, kodwa uthula. Uthi: "Ungakhulumi, Nomzi. Ungayinyakazisi indlovu." Ngemuva komzuzu indlovu iyahamba. UMandlenkosi uthi: "Ngempela ngishaqekile. Ngiyesaba izindlovu."

Bahamba futhi. UNomzi usombulula ibalazwe futhi, abheke indawo elandelayo. Ngaphansi kwesihlahla esikhulu kukhona ibhubesi lesifazane nezingane zalo ezintathu. Ibhubesi liyazikhotha izingane zalo. Likhotha ingane eyodwa ekhanda, bese likhotha enye. Ingane encane ikhotha unyawo lukanina. UNomzi uthi: "Ibhubesi alesabeki njengoba bengicabanga. Linothando ezinganeni zalo."

Kusihlwa, ngaphambi kokuthi baphume ehlathini, bafika endaweni enotshani obuningi. Phakathi kotshani kukhona ubhejane. Ubhejane mkhulu futhi mnyama, unezimpondo ezimbili ekhaleni. UMandlenkosi uthi: "Obhejane abasekho abaningi. Abantu bababulala ngenxa yezimpondo zabo." UNomzi uyashaqeka futhi, kodwa manje ushaqeka ngenxa yokudabuka.

Ekhaya uNomzi ubeka ibalazwe etafuleni. Ulisombulula okokugcina, adwebe indlovu, ibhubesi nobhejane kulo. Uthi: "Ngonyaka ozayo ngifuna ukubona ubhejane futhi."

Imibuzo:
UNomzi wenzani ngebalazwe?
Uyalisombulula emadolweni akhe, abheke imigwaqo nezindawo zezilwane.
Izindlovu ziphuza kanjani amanzi?
Zimunca amanzi ngekhala, bese ziwathela emlonyeni.
Kungani uMandlenkosi noNomzi beshaqeka?
Ngoba indlovu enkulu inyakazisa imoto yabo.
Ibhubesi lenzani ngaphansi kwesihlahla?
Likhotha izingane zalo ezintathu.
Kungani obhejane bengasekho abaningi?
Ngoba abantu bababulala ngenxa yezimpondo zabo.

lessons.title: Ilobolo eQunu
lessons.summary: Bachelor Mangaliso learns Xhosa phrases from his Thembu fiancée Mihlali and travels with his uncle to Qunu for the lobola talks; the hosts seat the guests, a wrong phrase embarrasses him, her uncle prefers cattle to money, and her father speaks of married life and the unity of two families.
lessons.text:
UMangaliso Ndimande uneminyaka engamashumi amathathu nesithupha. Abangane bakhe baseThekwini bahlale bethi: "Uyindela, Mangaliso. Uzoshada nini?" Manje indela ifuna ukushada. Uthanda uMihlali, intombi evela eQunu, isigodi esikude neThekwini. UMihlali ungumThembu.

AbaThembu bakhuluma isiXhosa. UMangaliso ukhuluma isiZulu, futhi isiXhosa akasazi kahle. Ngakho uMihlali umfundisa imishwana yesiXhosa. Umshwana wokuqala ungumshwana wokubonga. Umshwana wesibili ungumshwana wokubingelela abantu abadala. UMangaliso ubhala imishwana ephepheni, ayifunde nsuku zonke emotweni.

NgoMgqibelo umalume wakhe uNtuli nabanye abantu bomndeni bahamba ngemoto besuka eThekwini beya eQunu. Bayokhuluma ngelobolo. Uhambo lude kakhulu: amahora ayisishiyagalolunye emgwaqweni. UMangaliso uhamba nabo, kodwa ngokwesiko akangeni endlini lapho abadala bekhuluma khona ngelobolo.

Emzini kaMihlali umndeni wakhe uyabamukela. Umalume kaMihlali ubahlalisa endlini enkulu. Ubahlalisa ezihlalweni ezinde eduze kodonga, bese abantu bakhe behlala ngale kwendlu. UMangaliso ulinda ngaphandle.

Bese uMangaliso uzama isiXhosa sakhe. Ingane imnika amanzi okuphuza. UMangaliso uyibonga ngomshwana wokubonga. Kodwa akawusho ngendlela efanele, futhi ingane iyahleka. Abesifazane abaseduze nabo bayahleka. Lokhu kuyamphoxa uMangaliso. Ngempela umshwana omncane umphoxa kakhulu. Kodwa uMihlali uthi: "Ungazikhathazi. Bayakuthanda ngoba uyazama."

Endlini abadala bakhuluma ngelobolo amahora amathathu. Umalume kaMihlali uthi: "Ilobolo lethu ngelezinkomo eziyishumi." Umalume uNtuli uthi: "Singakhokha imali esikhundleni sezinkomo?" Kodwa umalume kaMihlali uncamela izinkomo kunemali. Uthi: "Siyazincamela izinkomo. Imali iyaphela, kodwa izinkomo ziyazala." Ekugcineni bavumelana: izinkomo eziyisithupha nemali.

Ngemuva kokukhuluma ngelobolo, ubaba kaMihlali ubiza uMangaliso endlini. Uyamhlalisa phansi eduze kwakhe. Uthi: "Ndodana yami, umendo awulula. Emendweni kudingeka uthando nokuhlonipha. Namuhla akuwona umendo wenu kuphela oqalayo. Kuqala futhi ubunye bemindeni yethu emibili, amaZulu nabaThembu."

UMangaliso ubonga ngesiXhosa. Kulokhu umshwana wakhe ulungile. Wonke umuntu uyahleka, kodwa manje bahleka ngoba bejabule. Ubaba kaMihlali uthi: "Ubunye buqala kanje: ngokufunda ulimi lomunye." Umalume uNtuli uyahleka, athi: "Indela yethu izoshada ngempela! Ngiyabuthanda ubunye bemindeni yethu."

Imibuzo:
Kungani abangane bakaMangaliso bethi uyindela?
Ngoba uneminyaka engamashumi amathathu nesithupha, futhi akashadanga.
UMihlali ufundisani uMangaliso?
Umfundisa imishwana yesiXhosa, ngoba abaThembu bakhuluma isiXhosa.
Yini ephoxa uMangaliso?
Usho umshwana wokubonga ngendlela engafanele, futhi ingane nabesifazane bayahleka.
Umalume kaMihlali uncamelani?
Uncamela izinkomo kunemali.
Ubaba kaMihlali uthini ngomendo?
Uthi umendo awulula, futhi emendweni kudingeka uthando nokuhlonipha.

lessons.title: Imoto endala
lessons.summary: A plank falls off a lorry onto the door of Gabisile's old car near Westville; the insurance assessor points to a subsection on rust and says rust was the cause, she is disappointed, her photo makes the insurance pay half, and she and her son paint the new door.
lessons.text:
UGabisile Mncube uhlala eWestville. Nsuku zonke ushayela imoto yakhe endala aye emsebenzini eThekwini. Imoto yakhe ebomvu ineminyaka engamashumi amabili. Isivalo sayo esisodwa sinokugqwala okuncane.

NgoLwesibili ekuseni uGabisile ushayela emgwaqweni omkhulu. Phambili kwakhe kukhona iloli eligcwele amapulangwe. Ngokushesha ipulangwe elilodwa lisuka eloli, liyawa. Ipulangwe lishaya isivalo semoto kaGabisile. Uyashaqeka, kodwa uphilile. Iloli alimi, liyaqhubeka nohambo lwalo. UGabisile ubeka imoto eceleni komgwaqo, athathe isithombe sepulangwe nesivalo ngocingo lwakhe.

Isivalo sinembobo enkulu. UGabisile ushayela ihhovisi lomshwalense ocingweni. Uthi: "Nginomshwalense wemoto yami. Ipulangwe lishaye isivalo semoto yami." Indoda yasehhovisi ithi: "Sizothumela umuntu wethu ozobheka imoto."

Ngakusasa kufika uMtshali wasehhovisi lomshwalense. Ubheka isivalo isikhathi eside. Bese uthi: "Ngiyaxolisa, mama. Bheka isiqeshana sesithathu somshwalense wakho. Lesi siqeshana sithi umshwalense awukhokheli ukugqwala. Ngibona ukugqwala okuningi kulesi sivalo. Umsuka wembobo ukugqwala, hhayi ipulangwe."

UGabisile uyadumala kakhulu. Uthi: "Uthini? Umsuka wembobo yipulangwe! Ukugqwala kwakukuncane." UMtshali uthi: "Isiqeshana sisho kanjalo. Angikwazi ukwenza lutho." UGabisile udumele. Uyacabanga: abantu bomshwalense banezigidigidi zemali. Kungani bengafuni ukukhokha imali encane kanje? Uthi kuMtshali: "Ninezigidigidi zemali, kodwa anifuni ukukhokha!"

Bese uGabisile ukhumbula isithombe sakhe. Ukhipha ucingo lwakhe, akhombise uMtshali isithombe. Esithombeni kubonakala ipulangwe elikhulu eduze kwesivalo. UMtshali ubheka isithombe, athi: "Hhayi, isithombe sakho sishintsha konke. Umsuka wembobo yipulangwe ngempela. Kodwa ukugqwala kwakukhona futhi. Ngakho umshwalense uzokhokha uhhafu."

Uhhafu akuyona yonke imali, kodwa uGabisile akasadumali kakhulu. Umshwalense ukhokha uhhafu, futhi uGabisile ukhokha uhhafu omunye. Indoda elungisa izimoto ishintsha isivalo esidala, ifake isivalo esisha esimhlophe.

Manje imoto inombala obomvu, kodwa isivalo sayo simhlophe. NgoMgqibelo uGabisile nendodana yakhe bapenda isivalo. Bapenda kancane, ngombala obomvu. Ekupheleni kosuku yonke imoto inombala obomvu futhi. Indodana kaGabisile ithi: "Mama, sipende kahle kunendoda elungisa izimoto!"

Imibuzo:
Kwenzekani emotweni kaGabisile emgwaqweni omkhulu?
Ipulangwe lisuka eloli, lishaye isivalo semoto yakhe.
Isiqeshana sesithathu somshwalense sithini?
Sithi umshwalense awukhokheli ukugqwala.
Ekuqaleni uMtshali uthi yini umsuka wembobo?
Uthi umsuka wembobo ukugqwala, hhayi ipulangwe.
Kungani uMtshali eshintsha umqondo wakhe?
Ngoba isithombe sikaGabisile sibonisa ipulangwe eduze kwesivalo.
UGabisile nendodana yakhe benzani ngoMgqibelo?
Bapenda isivalo esisha ngombala obomvu.
UGabisile ucabangani ngemali yabantu bomshwalense?
Ucabanga ukuthi banezigidigidi zemali, kodwa abafuni ukukhokha imali encane.

lessons.title: Izimu ehlathini
lessons.summary: A folk tale: envious Nomakhosazana, whose envy turns to hatred, cruelly leaves her kind sister Nhlanzeko in the forest; Nhlanzeko follows smoke to an ogre's fire, a mouse tells her to cover herself with leaves, the ogre hurls his axe and misses, and the mouse leads her to their grandmother.
lessons.text:
Kudala kwakukhona izintombi ezimbili, uNomakhosazana omdala noNhlanzeko omncane. UNhlanzeko wayemnene, futhi wonke umuntu wayemthanda. UNomakhosazana wayenomona. Umona wakhe wakhula nsuku zonke. Ngemuva kwesikhathi umona waba yinzondo. Wayezitshela ukuthi: "Kungani bonke bethanda yena, bengangithandi mina?"

Ngelinye ilanga umama wabo wathi: "Hambani niye kugogo wenu ngale kwehlathi. Niphathe lokhu kudla kukagogo." Izintombi zahamba. Indlela yayinde, futhi ihlathi lalimnyama.

Phakathi kwehlathi uNomakhosazana wathi: "Ngizogijima ngiye phambili." Wagijima, washiya uNhlanzeko yedwa ehlathini. Lokho kwakuwunya olukhulu. UNomakhosazana wayenonya ngenxa yomona wakhe. UNhlanzeko wambiza ngezwi elikhulu, kodwa uNomakhosazana akabuyanga. Inzondo yakhe yayinamandla kunothando lwakhe.

Kwahlwa. UNhlanzeko wayesaba kakhulu. Ngale kwezihlahla wabona umusi. Wacabanga ukuthi: "Lapho kunomusi, kukhona umlilo. Lapho kunomlilo, kukhona abantu." Walandela umusi.

Kodwa umusi wawuphuma endlini yezimu. Abantu babethi izimu liyathakatha, futhi lidla abantu abahamba bodwa ebusuku. Ngokuthakatha kwalo lenza abantu balahleke ehlathini. Izimu lalihlezi eduze komlilo, lihlabelela. Eduze kwalo kwakukhona izembe elikhulu.

Igundane elincane laphuma emgodini, lathi kuNhlanzeko: "Xwaya, ntombazane! Lelo yizimu. Lizokudla. Zicike ngamakhasi, uthule." UNhlanzeko waqoqa amakhasi amaningi ezihlahleni. Wazicika ngawo wonke umzimba, walala phansi engathi lutho.

Izimu lezwa ukuthi kukhona umuntu. Lasukuma, lathatha izembe lalo. Lathi: "Ngizwa umuntu!" Lalijikijela izembe ezihlahleni. Izembe lafika eduze kukaNhlanzeko, kodwa alimthintanga. Izimu laphinde lalijikijela izembe, kodwa futhi alimtholanga, ngoba wayecikwe ngamakhasi.

Ngemuva kwesikhathi ingoma yezimu yanqamuka. Umsindo wonke wanqamuka. Izimu lalilele. Igundane lathi: "Manje, sukuma. Ngilandele." Igundane lamhola ehlathini ubusuku bonke. Ekuseni lamfikisa emzini kagogo wakhe.

UNomakhosazana wayefikile kugogo kakade. Wayethe kugogo: "UNhlanzeko ulahlekile ehlathini." Kodwa manje uNhlanzeko wangena, wamtshela ugogo yonke into. Ugogo wathi kuNomakhosazana: "Umona nenzondo kuyakwenza ube yizimu, nakuba ungumuntu. Unya lwakho lwalungambulala uNhlanzeko." Lokhu kwamphoxa kakhulu uNomakhosazana. Wakhala, wacela uxolo kuNhlanzeko. Kusukela ngalolo suku umona wakhe wanqamuka.

Imibuzo:
Kungani uNomakhosazana engamthandi uNhlanzeko?
Ngoba wayenomona, futhi umona wakhe waba yinzondo.
UNhlanzeko walandelani ehlathini?
Walandela umusi, ngoba wacabanga ukuthi kukhona abantu.
Igundane latshela uNhlanzeko ukuthi enzeni?
Lathi azicike ngamakhasi, athule.
Izimu lenzani ngezembe lalo?
Lalijikijela ezihlahleni, kodwa alimthintanga uNhlanzeko.
Ugogo wathini kuNomakhosazana?
Wathi umona nenzondo kuyamenza abe yizimu, nakuba engumuntu.
UNomakhosazana wenzani ngonya lwakhe?
Washiya uNhlanzeko yedwa ehlathini.

lessons.title: Epulazini likagogo
lessons.summary: Student Snenhlanhla tells of her holiday on her grandmother's farm in Ngwavuma: she helps her plough, plants potatoes and beans that need moisture or wilt, threshes maize while her grandmother talks about her childhood, mows grass, bakes bread, feeds the chickens and the baby, and sings the baby to sleep.
lessons.text:
Igama lami nginguSnenhlanhla. Ngifunda eGoli, kodwa ngamaholide ngihamba ngebhasi ngiye epulazini likagogo wami eNgwavuma. Uhambo luthatha amahora ayishumi. Ugogo uShezi uhlala epulazini nomzala wami nengane yakhe encane.

Ngosuku lokuqala ugogo uthi: "Snenhlanhla, ngicela ungilimise namuhla. Amandla ami amancane manje." Ngakho ngiyamlimisa ugogo. Sisebenza ndawonye ensimini kusukela ekuseni. Mina ngiqhuba izinkomo ezimbili, ugogo uhamba ngemuva kwazo. Ngemuva kwamahora amathathu ugogo uthi: "Ungilimisile kahle, ngane yami."

Ngosuku lwesibili sitshala amazambane nobhontshisi. Ugogo uthi umhlabathi udinga umswakama. "Uma kungekho mswakama, amazambane ngeke akhule, nobhontshisi uzobuna." Ngakho sithela amanzi ensimini njalo kusihlwa. Ekuseni umhlabathi unomswakama futhi. Ugogo ukhomba izitshalo zomakhelwane. Zibunile ngoba azinawo amanzi. Ugogo uthi: "Bheka lezo zitshalo. Uma ilanga lishisa kakhulu, izitshalo ziyabuna."

Ngosuku lwesithathu sibhula ummbila wonyaka odlule. Sibeka ummbila phansi phezu kwesikhumba, siwubhule ngezinduku. Ugogo uthi: "Ebuntwaneni bami ngangibhula ummbila nomama wami nsuku zonke." Uxoxa ngobuntwana bakhe isikhathi eside. Ebuntwaneni bakhe kwakungekho zimoto esigodini. Abantu babehamba ngezinyawo noma ngamahhashi.

Ngosuku lwesine ngigunda utshani eduze kwendlu. Utshani bukhule kakhulu. Ngibugunda kancane, ngoba ngikhathele. Umzala wami ugunda izinwele zengane yakhe ngaphandle elangeni.

Kusihlwa ugogo uyabhaka. Wenza isinkwa esikhulu embizeni phezu komlilo. Ngifunda ukubhaka naye, futhi ngosuku olulandelayo ngibhaka isinkwa ngedwa. Isinkwa sikagogo simnandi kakhulu kunesinkwa sasesitolo.

Ngaphambi kokudla ngidlisa izinkukhu. Izinkukhu zigijimela kimi uma zibona ummbila esandleni sami. Bese ngidlisa ingane yomzala wami, ngoba umzala wami usebenza ekhishini. Ingane idla amazambane athambile nobhontshisi. Ngemuva kokudla, ngiyayilalisa ingane. Ngiyayihlabelela ingoma kagogo, futhi ngemuva kwemizuzu emihlanu ingane iyalala. Umzala wami uthi: "Uyakwazi ukulalisa ingane kunami!"

Ngemuva kwamasonto amabili ngibuyela eGoli. Ugogo unginika amazambane nobhontshisi esikhwameni. Uthi: "Ngiyabonga ngokungilimisa. Buya futhi ngonyaka ozayo."

Imibuzo:
Ugogo ucela uSnenhlanhla ukuthi enzeni ngosuku lokuqala?
Ucela ukuthi amlimise, ngoba amandla akhe amancane manje.
Kungani izitshalo zomakhelwane zibunile?
Zibunile ngoba azinawo amanzi, futhi ilanga lishisa kakhulu.
Ugogo uxoxa ngani ngesikhathi bebhula ummbila?
Uxoxa ngobuntwana bakhe, lapho ayebhula ummbila nomama wakhe.
USnenhlanhla wenzani ngaphambi kokudla?
Udlisa izinkukhu nengane yomzala wakhe.
Ulalisa kanjani ingane?
Uyihlabelela ingoma kagogo, ingane ilale ngemuva kwemizuzu emihlanu.

lessons.title: Isitimela esiya ePitoli
lessons.summary: Football fan Thembekile takes the train from Johannesburg to the cup final in Pretoria with her face painted, meets Bonakele, a Swazi, and Pieter, who speaks Afrikaans; they get soaked, some fans shout insults, her team loses and she is disappointed, but the friendship counts more.
lessons.text:
UThembekile Mabaso uthanda ibhola kakhulu. NgoMgqibelo iqembu lakhe lizodlala umdlalo wamanqamu wendebe ePitoli. Lona ngumdlalo omkhulu wonyaka, umdlalo wamanqamu. UThembekile ugibela isitimela esisuka eGoli esiya ePitoli.

Isitimela sigcwele abalandeli bamaqembu omabili. UThembekile ugqoke ijezi leqembu lakhe, elinombala oluhlaza. Ubuso bakhe bupendiwe ngombala oluhlaza, ukuze agqamise umbala weqembu lakhe. Abanye abalandeli nabo bagqamisa imibala yamaqembu abo ngezingubo nangezigqoko.

Eduze kukaThembekile kuhlezi indoda egqoke ijezi elimnyama. Igama layo nguBonakele Dlamini. Ulandela iqembu elidlala neqembu likaThembekile. UBonakele uyiSwazi, uvela eSwazini, kodwa usebenza eGoli. Uthi: "Mina ngiyiSwazi, kodwa ngiyalithanda ibhola lalapha eGoli."

Ngale kwabo kuhlezi indoda emhlophe egama layo linguPieter. UPieter ukhuluma isiBhunu nomngane wakhe. Bese ekhuluma isiZulu kancane noThembekile. Uthi: "Ngifunde isiZulu emsebenzini. Ekhaya sikhuluma isiBhunu." UBonakele uthi: "Nami ngikhuluma isiBhunu kancane." Bobathathu bayahleka. Ngemuva kwehora bayimihlobo. UBonakele ungumhlobo kaThembekile, noPieter ungumhlobo wakhe. UThembekile uthi: "Namuhla nginemihlobo emibili emisha esitimeleni."

EPitoli liyana kakhulu. Bonke abalandeli bahamba ngezinyawo besuka esitimeleni beya enkundleni. Bonke banethile. UThembekile unethile kusukela ekhanda kuya ezinyaweni. UPieter uthi: "Lezi zimo zinzima. Kodwa namuhla ngumdlalo wamanqamu. Ngeke sibuyele ekhaya!"

Enkundleni umdlalo uqala. Imvula iyaqhubeka, futhi abadlali nabo banethile. Ngemuva kwemizuzu engamashumi amane iqembu likaBonakele lithola igoli. Abanye abalandeli beqembu likaThembekile bathukuthela. Baphonsa inhlamba kubadlali beqembu likaBonakele. Baphonsa inhlamba futhi kubantu abahlezi eduze kwabo. UThembekile akayithandi inhlamba. Uthi: "Inhlamba ayisizi lutho. Ibhola ngumdlalo, hhayi impi."

Ekugcineni iqembu likaThembekile liyahlulwa. UThembekile uyajabha kakhulu. Ujabhile ngoba iqembu lakhe lidlale kahle, kodwa alilitholanga igoli. UBonakele uyajabula, kodwa akahleki uThembekile. Uthi: "Ngiyaxolisa, mngane wami. Ngonyaka ozayo iqembu lakho lizophinde libe semdlalweni wamanqamu."

Ngemuva komdlalo bobathathu bagibela isitimela esifanayo babuyele eGoli. UPieter uthenga itiye elishisayo kubo bonke. Uthi: "Kulezi zimo, ubungane bukhulu kunomdlalo." UThembekile uyavuma. Ubungane babo bumnandi kunokunqoba. Bonke bathi bazohlangana futhi emdlalweni wamanqamu ozayo.

Imibuzo:
Kungani uThembekile egibela isitimela esiya ePitoli?
Ngoba iqembu lakhe lizodlala umdlalo wamanqamu wendebe ePitoli.
UThembekile ugqamisa kanjani umbala weqembu lakhe?
Ubuso bakhe bupendiwe ngombala oluhlaza.
UBonakele uvelaphi?
UyiSwazi, uvela eSwazini, kodwa usebenza eGoli.
Kungani uThembekile engayithandi inhlamba?
Ngoba inhlamba ayisizi lutho, futhi ibhola ngumdlalo, hhayi impi.
Kungani uThembekile ejabha?
Ngoba iqembu lakhe liyahlulwa emdlalweni wamanqamu.
UPieter uthini ngalezi zimo esitimeleni?
Uthi kulezi zimo ubungane bukhulu kunomdlalo.

lessons.title: Uhambo lwaseGibhithe
lessons.summary: A retired couple, Mfanozelwe and Hlobisile, travel to Egypt: they drink litres of water in Cairo, ride camels, sit out a sandstorm, fish on the Nile with an old fisherman and his knife, hear about Cleopatra's suicide and a revolution, and address letters to their grandchildren.
lessons.text:
UMfanozelwe noHlobisile Majola baneminyaka engamashumi ayisithupha. Bashade iminyaka engamashumi amathathu. Ngalo nyaka bafuna ukwenza uhambo olukhulu: bahamba ngebhanoyi besuka eGoli beya eKayiro, eGibhithe.

EKayiro kuyashisa kakhulu. Indoda ehola abavakashi, uKarim, ithi: "Phuzani amanzi amaningi. Lapha umuntu udinga amalitha amathathu amanzi ngosuku." UHlobisile uthenga amabhodlela amabili, ilitha ngalinye. Ngemuva kwamahora amabili uMfanozelwe uphuze amalitha amabili kakade.

Ngosuku lwesibili bahamba ngamakamela. Ikamela likaMfanozelwe likhulu futhi lide. Uma ikamela lisukuma, uMfanozelwe uyesaba. Ikamela likaHlobisile lincane, futhi lihamba kancane. UKarim uthi: "Ikamela lingahamba izinsuku eziningi lingaphuzanga amanzi." UMfanozelwe uthi: "Mina angikwazi ukwenza lokho! Nginike ilitha lamanzi."

Emini kufika isiphepho sesihlabathi. Umoya unamandla kakhulu, futhi isihlabathi sigcwala yonke indawo. Amakamela ayalala phansi. UKarim uthi: "Fihlani ubuso benu ngezingubo. Isiphepho sizodlula." Ngemuva kwemizuzu engamashumi amathathu isiphepho siyadlula. UHlobisile uthi: "Angizange ngibone isiphepho esinje empilweni yami!"

Ngosuku lwesithathu bahamba ngesikebhe emfuleni iNayile. Emfuleni kukhona abadobi abaningi. Badoba ngezinto zakudala, njengoba abantu babedoba eminyakeni eyizinkulungwane edlule. Indoda endala edobayo inika uMfanozelwe intambo, ithi: "Doba!" UMfanozelwe uyadoba, futhi uthola inhlanzi encane. Indoda endala iyisika ngommese wayo, iyipheke, bese bonke beyidla.

Esikebheni uKarim uxoxa ngezinto zakudala zaseGibhithe. Uthi: "Kudala kwakukhona inkosi yesifazane egama layo linguCleopatra. Ngesikhathi izitha zakhe zinqoba, wafa ngokuzibulala. Abantu bathi wazibulala ngenyoka." UHlobisile uthi: "Ukuzibulala kwakhe kudabukisa kakhulu."

UKarim uxoxa futhi ngokuphenduka kwezwe lakhe. Uthi: "Eminyakeni eyishumi nesihlanu edlule kwaba nokuphenduka okukhulu eGibhithe. Abantu abaningi baphuma emigwaqweni. Ukuphenduka kwashintsha uhulumeni wethu."

Kusihlwa uHlobisile uthenga ummese omuhle esitolo, ube yisipho sendodana yabo. Bese ebhala izincwadi ezincane kubazukulu babo. Uyazikhela izincwadi ngamunye: ubhala igama lomzukulu ngamunye phezu kwencwadi yakhe, nekheli lakhe eThekwini. Uthi kuMfanozelwe: "Ngiyikhele kahle le ncwadi? Angifuni ukuthi ilahleke." UMfanozelwe uthi: "Uyikhele kahle."

Imibuzo:
UKarim uthi umuntu udinga amalitha amangaki amanzi ngosuku?
Uthi umuntu udinga amalitha amathathu amanzi ngosuku.
Kwenzekani lapho kufika isiphepho sesihlabathi?
Umoya unamandla kakhulu, amakamela alale phansi, futhi bafihla ubuso babo.
UMfanozelwe wenzani emfuleni iNayile?
Uyadoba, futhi uthola inhlanzi encane.
UKarim uthi uCleopatra wafa kanjani?
Uthi wafa ngokuzibulala ngesikhathi izitha zakhe zinqoba.
UHlobisile wenzani kusihlwa?
Uthenga ummese, abhale izincwadi kubazukulu, azikhele ngamunye.
